Subject: Executive headcount roll-forward — proposal for Q1 2027

Team,

Following our planning session last week I attached a compact roll-forward for the executive slate we discussed. This version focuses on the immediate hires we need to commit to in Q1 to avoid go-to-market and product roadblocks: 1x VP of Product, 1x Head of Infra (exec-level), and expedited backup for the GC/Head of Legal candidate (Evelyn Ross, profile attached).

Key notes:
- Comp bands are summarized in the spreadsheet (tab: bands) with location adjustments (US west/eu).
- Financing for the Head of Infra will come from the reserved Q1 hiring pool (code: HC-Q1-2027).
- We propose rolling the VP of Product offer authority to the CRO + CEO for signoff; comp band mid-point is aligned with market.

Asks: please review and reply with either APPROVE / APPROVE WITH ADJUSTMENT (list adjustments) / HOLD by end of day Friday (12/11). If you need a short call, I can schedule next week.

Attachments: exec_hc_rollforward_q1_2027.xlsx; evelyn_ross_comp_band_proposal.pdf

--
Maya Srinivasan

Maya,

Thanks for the clear pack. A few follow-ups from my side:

- Can you call out the expected ramp timeline for the Head of Infra (30/60/90) in the spreadsheet? I want to validate how soon we can expect production ownership.
- For VP Product, happy in principle, but I need clarity on whether the hire will own GTM product decisions or be limited to roadmap. That affects comp band positioning.
- Finance: will the HC-Q1-2027 pool cover base + sign-on or just base? If sign-on isn't covered we should reserve an uplift.

If it helps I'll mark APPROVE PENDING FINANCE confirmation for the two product/infra roles. Approving GC candidate (Evelyn) looks fine; the comp band suggested is modest.
